why: Insets the shell by its COLLISION radius instead of its DRAWN nose reach -- the intuitive fix for issue #237, and the one that does not work: it leaves the visible nose 0.225 past the barrel opening, so the daylight pop the issue is about survives untouched. Worth pinning because the shell still spawns behind the plane, so every symbolic SHELL_SPAWN_FORWARD assertion in the tree stays green; only the two assertions that constrain the inset's SIZE can see it.
